Here we discuss our individual patients problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problem with collective current best evident based input.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis E blog also reflects my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box is welcome.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \" patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with diagnosis and treatment plan.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;A 65 yr old male resident of ersanigudem , daily labourer by occupation came with\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EChief complaints :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAltered sensorium since \u0026nbsp;20 days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EGeneralised weakness since 20 days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EDaily routine :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EBefore illness ( 4 yrs back)\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe gets up from bed at 5 am does his daily routine freshen up and then goes to his daily work like Wood work , sand work and then goes to farming ( vari natadam) and works upto 9 am and then have rice as his breakfast and then again works at the field upto 1 pm and then has lunch takes rest for 1 hr and then works at field upto 5 pm and then goes to home and takes bath and rests for some time and then has his dinner at around 8 : 30 pm and then goes to rest .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EAfter illness :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESince 4 yrs after he has been diagnosed with Dm and Htn , he feels weakness and not having enough strength for working and stopped going to work and just stays at home all the time has his breakfast lunch dinner and sometimes goes to walk around the village for chatting with neighbours and other villagers .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHOPI :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2020\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 4 yrs back the he had fever for 1 week and also at fine morning at 2 am he had suddenly fell from the bed and was lifted and made to sleep on the bed and also again at 5 am he again fell down from the bed where they felt suspicious and was taken to local hospital \u0026nbsp;was on investigating he was diagnosed with DM and HTN was admitted for 3 days , insulin was given and has been on medication ? Since then and then was apparently normal.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe stopped going to work since then and just sits and home idle as he feels weakness and body pains and difficult in bending and doing work\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2021\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESince 2 yrs he also had lower backache for which he used some medications ( analgesics? ) and had neglected it and no investigation or treatment has been done for that .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2023\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E20 days back he developed altered behaviour at morning started scolding his wife but his speech was not clear and has also been weak and was taken to local hospital at nakrekal and was investigated and his blood sugar levels were low and renal parameters were deranged was admitted for 3 days and was diagnosed as CKD and was advised for dialysis and then went home was fine for a week and then had been taken for nalgonda for medicine and dialysis and as there was no availability of dialysis there was reffered to our hospital.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThey visited our hospital and was advised to return back after a day due to some reasons and was taken home and then he started having lower limb weakness was unable to walk long distance and suddenly at 15.06.23 morning there was no speech and movements from the patient and was brought to our hospital on checking his GRBS was 20mg\/dl and was admitted.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/o increased frequency of micturition , pain during micturition\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/o burning micturition , hematuria , any urge for micturition,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o palpitations,sweating, orthopnea, pnd\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o Fever,cough, cold .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPast history:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EKnown case Of DM since 4 yrs , HTN since 4 yrs and is medication ? Since then .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/o fistulectomy 5 yrs back .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o Tb, Asthma, epilepsy,CAd, thyroid disorders .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPersonal history:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient is daily labourer by occupation stopped working since 4 yrs on being diagnosed with DM and HTN and was married 45 yrs back and Has no Children , His 1st boy child was born and died with 1 day of birth , His 2 nd girl child was born after 4 yrs after 1st pregnancy and died with 2 months after birth.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDiet - Mixed\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESleep - Adequate\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAppetite- Decreased since 20 days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBowel and bladder movemnts- Decreased bowel movements since 7 days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAddictions: He has habit of drinking toddy everyday since 22 yrs of age and has habit of drinking alcohol occasionally at functions (180ml )\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHas no smoking habits\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o any allergies .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EGeneral examination:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient is Consious , non coherent, cooperative , mod built and mod nourished .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPallor is present\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;
